name: DBS Stainless Steel Fabricators
old_description: Established in 1985, DBS Stainless Steel Fabricators has become a trusted name in Metal Fabrication, specializing in custom stainless steel products for the Cincinnati Tri-State Area and beyond. Our range of expertise encompasses Restaurant Equipment, Industrial Parts, and Residential Countertops, ensuring we can meet the unique needs of diverse industries. DBS understands the demanding nature of the Restaurant Industry and offers a wide selection of solutions, from Chef's Counters to Wall Panels and Corner Guards, assisting our clients in creating custom and durable workspaces. With over 40 years of experience, our commitment to delivering superior quality products, and exceptional service sets us apart as the leading innovators in our field.
about:
DBS Stainless Steel Fabricators was established in 1985 in Hamilton, Ohio, serving the Cincinnati Tri-State Area with custom stainless steel fabrication. The company began as a metal fabrication shop focused on stainless steel products.

The shop specializes in custom stainless steel fabrication across three main categories: restaurant equipment, industrial parts, and residential countertops. Its capabilities include forming, welding, and finishing stainless steel into items such as chef's counters, wall panels, corner guards, bar tops, shelving, and custom residential pieces. Project records from 2016 through 2025 show work ranging from commercial bar installations to residential countertops and specialty items like copper and brass counter tops.

DBS serves the restaurant industry, industrial clients, and residential customers. Notable projects include stainless steel laundry and trash receptacles for the Cincinnati Bengals, custom countertops for the Indian Hill Residence, and custom steps for an Airstream trailer. The company also produces bar and restaurant fixtures such as pass-through counters, condiment stands, and steam counters.

The company cites its commitment to quality craftsmanship and service as what distinguishes it in the field, built on over four decades of fabrication experience.
